reviews.text: My sweet elderly collie had been struggling with walking, and I felt like every time we took her in the car, the limping would get worse. I was very lucky to find Dr. Olson and his team were available le to come to my home the next day. It was worth every penny because the team spent a few hours on my home taking care of my dog and coming up with a reasonable game plan to keep my dog alive and with a good quality of life. We will continue to use Dallas Veterinary Concierge in the future.
Dr Olson and his staff are great!   They have helped my older dog immensely!  Highly recommend!!!

Dr. Olson & his team exhibit such caring energy & really made an effort to help my 20 year old cat feel at ease in their presence. His traveling clinic is truly impressive. I highly recommend giving them the opportunity to care for your fur babies!
Very pleased with Dr Olson and his team. You all will enjoy the professionalism on top of the care and knowledge this mobile clinic will show you and your family.
Daniel was personable, gentle with our terrified cats, and efficient.
Thank you for the show of support!
Extremely supportive and accommodating!
Thank you so much for the show of support! It was a pleasure meeting you and Noah for a house call 🐈‍⬛ …
The vet that came out was very caring and did a great job ensuring our dog passed in the most peaceful way possible.

Dr. Marchand was wonderful! She was very sweet, and exhibited peace and calm throughout. My precious German Shepherd never liked going to a veterinary office, so the ability to protect him from that added angst, in his last hours, by having a veterinarian come to his home was comforting, and immensely appreciated! Even though the occasion was extremely sad for me, and my daughter, we have shared happy tears about how thankful we were to have chosen Dallas Veterinary Hospice.

Can't say enough about the professionalism and care our family and beloved fur baby recieved in such a heartbreaking time. Dr. Tran was amazing when he came out to help us send Maximus off across the rainbow bridge, and he was picked up and transported to the crematorium for a private cremation. We weren't expecting to have him back home as soon as we did, compared to how long its taken in the past with other services and pets. He came home very quickly and was also dropped off to our home so we didn't have to arrange for him to be picked up ourselves. This whole experience was truly great and should we need any services with future pets, we know exactly who we are working with. Thank you!
We are beyond grateful for everyone who works here. Dr Williams showed up when we didn’t think anyone would and showed our family such kindness and compassion on one of the worst days of our life.

Dr. Dan was kind and compassionate and I cannot praise him enough. We hope that we will never need end-of-life care for our beloved companions, but when it becomes necessary, I wish for all animals to have the gentle care of Dr. Dan and DVC.

Quick response and everyone I had contact with answered questions and shared information with patience and empathy during a very stressful time with my sick dog. They accommodated my request for a visit with short notice. Dr. Williams came to our home and she was so gentle and caring for both my dog and me. There was no rush through the visit and for that I am so grateful. Losing my dog is losing my baby and is very traumatic, but he was treated with dignity and kindness.

This is our second time that we have used Dr. Dan's group for end of life care. We won't use anyone else! I carry his business card in my wallet and give the number to my pet sitter when we leave the dogs. It is so comforting to know that our dear pets can just go to sleep among her familiar environment and with her loving parents. It is a bit expensive for people on limited income, however, it is worth it for our family member to be at home with their parents and siblings. Every time we use this service, it is a great experience. Every Vet we have seen has been great. I highly recommend this service.

Just amazing! If you want someone to come to your home and take very good care of your pet call Dr Daniel Olson!! His assistant Veronica was amazing too!! He takes his time he treated our dog like it was his dog. Made sure Rio had everything he needed and some. They make it so easy for you. They come so prepared very clean very detailed. Rio is very difficult to work with and he went out of his way and bought something extra and special just for Rio.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Olson and his entire team. As a pet parent to two senior dogs, Lady and Dudley, having a veterinarian who truly understands and prioritizes elderly care has meant everything to me.

Dudley has had epilepsy since 2021, and there was a time when his seizures became so intense that I feared his life expectancy would be much shorter than we ever anticipated. Instead of accepting that as the end of the road, Dr. Olson continued researching, adjusting medications, and offering alternative treatment options to tailor a plan specifically for Dudley. His persistence, knowledge, and genuine care quite literally has given us more quality time together.

He is patient, thorough, and never makes you feel rushed. He takes the time to explain options and truly partners with you in your pet’s care. That level of compassion is rare.

His staff is equally incredible — Veronica and team responds quickly to emails about appointments and medication refills, and are always kind, organized, and helpful. It truly feels like a small business that cares deeply about every client and every animal that walks through the door.

If you are looking for a veterinarian who treats your pets like family — especially senior pets who need extra attention — I highly recommend Dr. Dan and his clinic.
Thank you! ❤️

Dr Olson is so gentle, caring and explains everything that is going on with your pet and what he is doing step by step. We used him a couple of years ago and again last month. He comes to your house and takes care of your pet in their own surroundings to make them comfortable. He checks back in by text and phone. If meds are needed afterwards, he or his assistant deliver to your doorstep and you pay by a link. My 15 year old lab needs a lot of care right now and Dr Olson is a blessing right now.

I am so grateful for Dr. Olson!  He was kind, compassionate and really listened to my care goals for my sweet geriatric pup Ellie. We weren’t sure what options we had left to make sure she had a good quality of life and Dr. Olsen gave us a clear, realistic and effective care plan for her!

I simply cannot say enough about the level of care and concern my sweet dog and I received from Doctor Olson. I was traveling to Dallas with my dog and had some concerns about my little guys’ health. Dr. Olson got us in same day and was so thorough. Without his help we would not have been able to proceed on our vacation. Being with Dr. Olson put my mind at ease and my little Max loved him so much.

We first met Dr. Olson during a challenging time when our previous dog was nearing the end of life. His compassion and empathy made a difficult situation more bearable. Dr. Olson is not just a vet; he's an exceptional caregiver, offering patience, engagement, and resourcefulness. The care he provides surpasses expectations, making him feel more like a best friend than a traditional vet. You can trust that you're receiving top-notch care from someone who truly understands and supports you emotionally.
Dr. O, was fabulous! He was prompt and kind to both me and Sydney. I had called to have Sydney put to sleep so I can safely say he saved his life.
We love Dr. Olsen!!! He’s the only vet we trust in DFW!!!!
Dr. Dan connects with your pets quickly. He is empathetic and knowledgeable. We believe our 15 year old Aussie Beau has benefited immensely from his care.

As a concierge vet, Dr. Olson is exceptional—patient, kind, responsive, and genuinely devoted to his furry patients. He and his team guided us through the final months and moments of three of our senior pets with extraordinary compassion and dignity. I’m deeply grateful for his care and can’t recommend him highly enough. 😻 …
Dr. Olsen has been with us for a few years.  He provided great care for our last dog and now, has helped us with Griffin, our rescue family member.
